prompt:
Convert each of the following measurements into an equivalent value in base units without prefixes, expressing your answers in standard scientific form:
(a) an electric current of $48\text{ \mu A}$ [1]
(b) a time duration of $350\text{ ps}$ [1]

mark_scheme.criterion: (a) 4.8 x 10^-5 A (allow 48 x 10^-6 A) with unit A.
(b) 3.5 x 10^-10 s (allow 350 x 10^-12 s) with unit s.

hints: Adjust into standard scientific form: a x 10^b with 1 <= a < 10.
teacher_walkthrough: Both answers require correct units (A and s).

provenance.abstract_pattern: prefix conversion to base units with scientific form
provenance.independence_statement: Authored as an original drill converting micro and pico measurements.
